title: Mini Blush Veil & Skin Enhancer Duo™
descriptionHtml:
✓ Vegan✓ Medium Coverage✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Cream Formula✓ Light Coverage✓ Radiant Finish
What it is: A mini compact featuring Mario’s dewy blush and bronzer balms in artist-approved pairs.

Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclocarban, triclosan, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance. These products are also vegan, gluten-free, and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: The Soft Pop Plumping Cream Blush Veil is a weightless cream blush balm made with hyaluronic acid to hydrate and visibly plump skin with a sheer veil of color. The SoftSculpt Transforming Skin Enhancer® is a skin enhancer in a three-in-one cream bronzer that warms, shapes, and even
How to Use+

Suggested Usage:

SoftSculpt Transforming Skin Enhancer®:

-For targeted sculpting, use the smaller side of the F4 Brush (sold separately) to apply where the sun would naturally hit (the high points of the cheeks, the nose, and below the hairline).

-For all-over warmth, use the larger side of the F4 Brush to sweep product all over.


Soft Pop Plumping Cream Blush Veil:

-Apply the Soft Pop Plumping Blush Veil over the SoftSculpt Transforming Skin Enhancer® or your favorite base for a warm, dewy look.

-Work the F1 Brush (sold separately) into the Blush Veil until hairs are evenly coated, then apply onto the apples of the cheeks, blending up towards the temple.

-Apply with fingertips for an even more natural effect.

Ingredients+
SoftSculpt Transforming Skin Enhancer®:
C15-19 Alkane, Octyldodecanol, Pentaerythrityl Tetraisostearate, Tridecyl Trimellitate, Synthetic Wax, Raphanus Sativus Seed Extract (Raphanus Sativus (Radish) Seed Extract), Cera Microcristallina (Microcrystalline Wax), Mica, Silica Silylate, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Hydrogenated Rice Bran Wax, Disteardimonium Hectorite, Oryza Sativa Bran Cera (Oryza Sativa (Rice) Bran Wax), Dicalcium Phosphate, Tocopheryl Acetate, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Tin Oxide, Helianthus Annuus Seed Oil (Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil), Rosmarinus Officinalis Leaf Extract (Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Extract) [May Contain/Peut Contenir (+/-): Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492), Blue 1 Lake (Ci 42090)].

Soft Pop Plumping Cream Blush Veil:
C15-19 Alkane, Octyldodecanol, Tridecyl Trimellitate, Pentaerythrityl Tetraisostearate, Synthetic Wax, Raphanus Sativus (Radish) Seed Extract, Microcrystalline Wax/Cera Microcristallina, Mica, Silica Silylate, Oryza Sativa (Rice) Bran Wax/Oryza Sativa Bran Cera, Disteardimonium Hectorite, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Dicalcium Phosphate, Tocopheryl Acetate, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Sodium Hyaluronate, Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Tin Oxide, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Extract. May Contain/Peut Contenir (+/-): Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492), Red 6 (Ci 15850), Red 28 Lake (Ci 45410).
